categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, production, sales, and technical services of molecular sieve adsorbents and catalysts. Its products serve industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy chemical, petrochemical, environmental governance, and related fields. The product portfolio includes over 140 types of molecular sieve materials covering a wide price range, with applications in gas separation, life health, adsorption drying, environmental protection, and petrochemical industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced molecular sieve synthesis and forming technologies, including controlled crystal size, exchange degree, and silicon-aluminum ratio of molecular sieve raw powders. It employs high-efficiency, energy-saving drying and vacuum roasting processes to enhance product performance and reduce costs. The company has a 'produce one generation, reserve one generation, research one generation' product iteration strategy, maintaining leading technology levels. It also integrates synthesis mother liquor recycling and ion exchange technologies to optimize raw material usage.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic and international industrial gas companies, petrochemical enterprises, medical oxygen providers, and environmental protection entities. The company serves industries such as coal chemical, petrochemical, metallurgy, building materials, environmental governance, and emerging sectors like automotive manufacturing and semiconductor specialty gases. Major customers include China National Petroleum, Linde Gas, Air Liquide, and Glencore, with products applied in large-scale industrial gas separation and petrochemical projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Luoyang, Henan Province. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Thailand (Jalon Thailand) serving Southeast Asia and other international markets. The company actively expands overseas markets including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Central Asia, with export sales growing significantly. The Thailand production base supports local and international customers with flexible product specifications.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the molecular sieve supply chain, producing molecular sieve raw powders, activated powders, and formed molecular sieve products. It controls the full industrial chain from raw material synthesis to product forming and activation, providing integrated technical services and solutions. This vertical integration enables quality control, cost management, and product innovation advantages over competitors relying on external raw powder suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technology innovation in molecular sieve materials, expanding applications in energy chemical, petrochemical, environmental governance, and emerging fields like low-concentration coalbed methane enrichment and CO2 capture. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintaining over 4% of revenue in R&D expenses, and operates multiple joint laboratories with universities and research institutes. It focuses on developing high-performance, cost-effective, and differentiated molecular sieve products and catalysts to enhance market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of molecular sieve materials and catalysts to industrial customers, supplemented by technical consulting and integrated solution services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model domestically, with exports growing rapidly. It also provides customized products and technical support services, enhancing customer value and fostering long-term partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic molecular sieve manufacturer, ranked first in China and third globally by production capacity. It competes with international giants like Honeywell UOP, Arkema CECA, and Zeochem in the mid-to-high-end market segments. Domestically, it is among the top-tier players alongside Zhongchu Mo, Qilu Huaxin, and others, distinguished by its full industrial chain, scale, and innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 972 million, a 13.87% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 153 million, a 22.65% decrease due to increased expenses in talent acquisition, R&D, and market expansion. Total assets grew 38.57% to RMB 3.03 billion, and net assets increased 14.8% to RMB 1.78 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, differentiated molecular sieve products with superior adsorption capacity, selectivity, and energy efficiency, enabling import substitution in key industrial applications. Its full industrial chain control ensures product consistency, cost competitiveness, and rapid innovation cycles. The company also offers integrated technical solutions, including product selection, design, and on-site support, enhancing customer satisfaction and fostering long-term cooperation. Its commitment to green manufacturing and ESG principles further differentiates it in the market.
